tech.name: Philip K. Dick android
tech.maker: David Hanson (Hanson Robotics) and Andrew Olney
tech.description: A conversational android of the author whose novel became Blade Runner. Its head went missing on a flight in 2006 and was never found.

references.title: "Do androids dream of freedom?" Al Jazeera
David F. Dufty, How to Build an Android (Henry Holt)

tech.name: Cybertruck
tech.description: An angular steel pickup. Musk called it a "Blade Runner" pickup truck and unveiled it on 21 November 2019, in the month and year the film is set.

references.title: Craig Trudell (Bloomberg), "Elon Musk schedules 'Blade Runner'-inspired truck unveil for Nov. 21," FleetOwner

tech.name: DOOH.com digital billboards
tech.description: A company making live, dynamic digital billboard adverts. Its CEO says Blade Runner made him want to work in digital advertising.

references.title: Emma Ledger, "Advertising our future," The Independent
